Source: https://github.com/media-kit/media-kit/tree/c533e446755f51cf53c7e57aea873f2aa5355f81/libs/windows/media_kit_libs_windows_video

The upstream Windows ARM64 package is not yet published on pub.dev. This pinned copy removes workspace resolution and upstream development dependencies for use as a path dependency. Runtime code and library checksums are upstream. MIT license retained.

ARM64 ANGLE archive: media-kit PR #1381, https://github.com/talynone/flutter-windows-ANGLE-OpenGL-ES/releases/tag/v1.0.1. Selects the ARM64 binaries and ships their libc++ runtime; x64 keeps the upstream archive.
